'''LI-45''' was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] stationed aboard the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] prototype [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnought]] [[Javelin (Harrower-class)|''Javelin'']]. As part of a trap laid by the Empire, most of the crew left the ''Javelin,'' leaving LI-45 behind and tasking him to rig the ship with [[Detonite/Legends|detonite]] to kill the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] strike team that was trying to capture the ship.<ref name="Shattering" />
